SELECT stu.student_name studentName , stu.students_phone phone , c_time.total_number total , c_time.total_number - c_time.remaining_number number , c_time.remaining_number remainNumber , c.course_name courseName , cls_info.class_name className FROM bd_student stu RIGHT JOIN bd_course_time c_time ON c_time.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN bd_course c ON c_time.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cls.class_name class_name, stu_cls.student_id student_id, stu_cls.class_id class_id, cls.class_course_id class_course_id FROM bd_class cls, bd_student_class stu_cls WHERE stu_cls.class_id = cls.id AND stu_cls.is_delete = 0 AND stu_cls.mec_id = #{mecId} AND stu_cls.campus_id = #{campusId} ) cls_info ON stu.id = cls_info.student_id AND c.id = cls_info.class_course_id WHERE stu.is_delete = 0 and stu.mec_id = #{mecId} and stu.campus_id = #{campusId} AND c_time.is_delete = 0 AND c.is_delete = 0 AND cls_info.class_name IS NOT NULL AND cls_info.class_name != ''
and stu.student_name like CONCAT('%',#{studentName},'%')
and stu.students_phone like CONCAT('%',#{phone},'%')
and c.course_name like CONCAT('%',#{courseName},'%')
and cls_info.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')
ORDER BY stu.create_time DESC
, stu.id desc
